text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Be brilliant. Be supreme. Always shine 
the brightest.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"That is the golden rule of our— the 
'Splendid Clan.'"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As one who counts herself among their 
ranks, this is the principle that I, 
Daiichi Ruby, must uphold above all else.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Conversations, actions, even the smallest 
daily mannerisms. This golden rule must 
permeate through every single one of them.

Today, in order to understand the proper 
mindset for training her, I was invited to 
Daiichi Ruby's family estate.

The "Splendid Clan"... Before long, people 
began referring to her family by that name 
for their glittering accomplishments in 
Japan.

Her family has left their mark on 
politics, finance, sports... every 
industry imaginable. There's no one in 
this country who doesn't know their name.

And the "Illustrious Lineage" had left 
great achievements in the Twinkle Series 
that she was about to challenge.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Please look at the portrait behind you.

Portraits of Umamusume, shining more 
brilliantly than the gorgeous 
chandeliers... Every one of them has an 
unapproachable gaze, just like Daiichi 
Ruby's.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume of my clan has performed 
in a manner worthy of our family name.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Above all, my mother achieved such great 
success that people even referred to my 
grandmother—a legendary Umamusume in her 
own right—as "that Umamusume's mother."

I know her mother well. She's a legendary 
Umamusume who won renowned races and still 
holds the Junior Class course record to 
this day.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Mother is the greatest masterpiece of our 
family. She was the one who best embodied 
our golden rule.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Be magnificent. Be supreme. Always shine 
with the greatest brilliance...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
In other words, deliver a magnificent run 
upon the supreme stage, and claim the 
brightest radiance—victory.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"My mother, who produced stellar results 
along the royal road of the Triple Tiara, 
is truly my role model."

The Triple Tiara route refers to the 
glamorous path consisting of the Oka Sho, 
the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho, which can 
only be challenged during the Classic 
year.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The mission I must fulfill also lies 
within these sacred tenets.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
From the day I was graced with the honor 
of being born into this clan, what was 
bestowed upon me—was duty.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming every obstacle, risking life 
and limb... I must fulfill this duty at 
all costs.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
All of it—for the sake of the "Magnificent 
Clan."

Daiichi Ruby gazes straight at me. Her 
stare overlaps with the gazes of the 
Umamusume in the framed portraits... and 
once again, the pressure weighs down on 
me.
choice_data_list:
(Ever since that day, that responsibility 
has been mine too.)

(Ever since that day, that responsibility 
has been mine too.)

text_block_list.text:
To form a contract with her, born of a 
glorious clan, I overcame numerous 
challenges—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"No one else remains besides you. Last 
night, all the others withdrew from the 
competition."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, you have been hired as my 
Trainer. That concludes my explanation.

From that day on, when I somehow became 
her Trainer, despite taking a rather 
passive route—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That is the mindset we must share before 
moving on to full-scale training.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As my Trainer, I expect you to maintain at 
least a bare minimum of dignified conduct.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Your voice is pitching up. Please project 
properly using abdominal breathing.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Let us return to the academy and begin 
today's training."

"...If this is how it is already, can she 
truly overcome this heavy pressure...? 
Still, she had a reason why she couldn't 
back down."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ――1600 meters, I'm off to run.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!!

In the final stretch, her legs unleashed a 
sudden flash of speed— I decided to become 
a Trainer because I was captivated by that 
brilliant closing kick.
choice_data_list: (In the end—I still want to support her)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: How was my run just now?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am deeply grateful.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However, please give me an objective 
evaluation, not a subjective emotional 
one."

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
――My Lady, Trainer-sama. Pardon my 
interruption while you are speaking.

Daiichi Ruby has many obligations such as 
dinner meetings, so her butler is granted 
special permission to enter and leave the 
academy. His primary duties are managing 
her schedule and driving her around.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Preparations for the press conference are 
complete. When it's time, please take the 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As I mentioned the other day, I will be 
arranging a platform for you to declare 
your aspirations after training in 
preparation for your debut.

Due to her pedigree, she drew massive 
public attention, and a press conference 
was scheduled at the reporters' request 
even before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It will also serve as the venue to 
officially introduce you, my Trainer, to 
the public for the first time.
—Whew! Insane~~♪

"Look at her!! She is sooooo freakin' 
cute, right!?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
“—First off, congratulations on having 
your debut decided!”

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Following in the footsteps of your 
grandmother and mother who achieved such 
glorious records... No, I pray with all my 
heart that you will surpass even them.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am deeply grateful.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
By the way... are you the one who signed a 
trainer contract with Daiichi Ruby?

I caught a glance from Daiichi Ruby. It 
seemed to signal that I could handle this 
myself.
choice_data_list: Yes, I'm her trainer in charge.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"It is an honor to finally meet you. The 
person who formed a contract with Daiichi 
Ruby-san... Just how exceptional must you 
be!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
In your own opinion, what aspects of your 
performance do you think were evaluated 
favorably?
choice_data_list:
(There's no way I can say it was just a 
coincidence...!)

text_block_list.text:
The reporters' expectant gazes pierce 
right through me. I have no track record, 
nor any prestigious lineage. There's 
nothing about me to praise—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes, do not forget that image. If you have 
an ideal to strive for, carry yourself in 
a manner worthy of it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely what will eventually 
transform you into the figure you desire 
to be."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You saw it through to the very end. 
Splendidly done.

“—Even so, it's a fact that I'm standing 
here right now as Daiichi Ruby's Trainer. 
If that's the case, I should hold my head 
high...!”
choice_data_list: I believe they recognized my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Meaning...?
choice_data_list:
I am prepared to stake my very life to 
achieve the ultimate brilliance!

text_block_list.text:
As the Trainer of a girl aiming for the 
top, I resolved to keep pushing forward. 
In that case... it's not a question of 
'can I do it,' but simply 'doing it.'

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Here and now, I declare this before 
everyone."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The "ultimate radiance" we strive for... 
lies along the Triple Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Could it be...?! Will we see the glorious 
return of the "Illustrious Clan" in this 
era...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes. Please look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap...!)

Enveloped by a standing ovation. The sheer 
volume makes the crushing pressure feel 
even heavier. At that moment—

Ayyyyy~â Look who's getting all hyped 
up~!!

Whew, look at that! Riding the wave, 
aren'tcha!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios in the hoooouse! Annnnd... 
next up...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, cute little ojou-sama! How 
about you become my number one bae~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right? Wanna party now? Wanna party with 
me!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I do not know who you are, but we are 
currently holding a press conference.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The press is waiting, so please leave. You 
may schedule an appointment with that 
butler over there later.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
I can help you with that, so please step 
this way.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?!! Whoa! Oooooh~~?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pien, mega salty!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tbh, that part of her is super adorbs 
too~! We're so gonna become besties, 
totally☆

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Uh... Well...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Well then.

The moment Daiichi Ruby began to speak, 
the room fell dead silent. In the 
transformed atmosphere, she gazed straight 
aheadâ

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please bear witness to this new chapter in 
the history of the "Splendid Clan."
